what: a flint hoe: the blade of crude knapped grey-brown flint with chipped faceted edges, a plain wooden handle, the head lashed on with tan sinew cord. Same shape as the attached iron hoe: at the handle's top a short neck reaches out to ONE side (the upper left) and a flat blade turns down from it, an L, never a T; nothing past the handle on the other side. 2 px margin; no straight vertical edge
